speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms. To begin my assessment, can you describe the specific appearance and distribution of the rash?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, could you describe the specific characteristics of the rash on your palms and any exposure to water or fish?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, SPEP, UPEP.
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatoscopy_of_palm_rash.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease).

The combination of hypopigmented macules, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and peripheral neuropathy (numbness/tingling) in a patient with livestock and farm exposure is highly specific for leprosy. The rash on the upper body and face is consistent with the disease presentation.
